purpose: Separate model ranking from portfolio construction by replaying the identical D10 OOF Top10 score rows under frozen legal exit horizons and capital/overlap policies.

frozen_policies.score: same D10 sequence/tree within-date mean-rank OOF score

capital_policies.fixed_daily_cohort_10pct: Invest at most 10% of prior equity in each daily cohort for every exit horizon.
capital_policies.horizon_normalized_full_investment: Invest at most 1/H of prior equity per cohort so H overlapping cohorts target roughly full gross exposure.

overlap_policies: skip a symbol while an earlier cohort is open and retain cash without rank substitution
